list.title: Products and services
list.description: The organization catalog used to build deal items.

dialog.title: New product
dialog.description: Add a product or service with price, currency and unit.

detail.deleteDescription: {{name}} leaves the catalog. Deal items that already use it keep their name, price and unit.

items.title: Deal items
items.searchPlaceholder: Search products by name or code
items.otherCurrency: Priced in {{currency}}: different from the deal currency
items.emptyDescription: Add catalog products or free items with quantity, price and discount.
items.noAccessDescription: Your role cannot see deal amounts, so the items are hidden.
items.removeDescription: {{name}} will be removed from the deal.
items.autoNotice: The amount of this deal is the sum of its items and cannot be edited directly.
items.autoNoticeEmpty: Once it has items, the deal amount becomes their sum.
items.manualNotice: Items are informative: the deal amount stays manual.

settings.title: Products and items
settings.description: Choose how the deal amount relates to its items.

modeHints.manual: The amount is typed on the deal; items are informative only.
modeHints.items: Deals with items get their amount calculated automatically and the field becomes read-only. Deals without items stay manual.

settings.switchHint: Current amounts are not rewritten: each deal follows the sum on the next change of its items or with "Use total as amount".
settings.conflict: Someone else changed the settings. The data was reloaded.
